feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 23 November 2026 11:45am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 23 November 2026 at 11:45am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure and associated frontal zones to the west of Ireland as a ridge of high pressure centred in the Norwegian Sea extends south to cover much of the east of the British Isles.


##Wind##

South or southeast 4 or 5, increasing southeast 5 or 6 this afternoon, then 6 or 7 this evening, and occasionally gale 8 later tonight.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, building moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Mainly fair at first, then patchy rain later in the evening becoming more widespread tomorrow morning.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain later.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Southeast 6 or 7, occasionally gale 8, becoming mainly 7 or gale 8 for a time Tuesday afternoon, then becoming cyclonic 3 to 5 in the southwest of the area during Tuesday afternoon. Becoming east or southeast 4 or 5 in all waters later.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, becoming mainly moderate later.


##Weather##

Outbreaks of rain, heavy at times.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor.
